newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closed up slightly vs US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closed up slightly vs US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up slightly at 8.2962 on Wednesday from a two-month closing low of 8.2964 on Tuesday against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai on a technical rebound, traders said.
The weighted average price on Tuesday was 8.2958.
The yuan opened higher at 8.2958 and moved around 8.2960 for most of the session, hitting an intraday low of 8.2964 and a high of 8.2930.
Trading was active, with most done around 8.2960, traders said.
"Though selling pressure was seen at about 8.2955, the yuan gained solid support below 8.2960," said one dealer.
"Speculative buying pushed the yuan to an intraday high of 8.2930, but as usual it won't have any impact on the market," he added.
Dealers expected the yuan to move around 8.2960 on Thursday.
The yuan closed slightly down at 6.7650 from 6.7098 against 100 Japanese yen and down at an intraday low of 1.0718 from 1.0701 against the Hong Kong dollar.
